title: ReservationCancelled
description: Booking afmeldt: a member gave up their seat on a class session. Published by Booking, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

reservationId.description: The reservation's id in Booking, the same id reservation-made carried. A reservation is cancelled once, so consumers use it to handle the same event only once.

classSessionId.description: The id of the class session the seat was on.

memberId.description: The member who gave up the seat (MemberId, from Membership).

startTime.description: When the class session starts, ISO 8601 with an offset.

isLateCancellation.description: Sen afmelding: cancelled less than 2 hours before the start. Statistics only, no consequence.
